zh.title: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空波音767客機發動機火警指示轉降菲律賓達沃
zh.summary: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空一架波音767-300ER執飛香港往莫士比港航班時接獲發動機火警指示，轉降菲律賓達沃；機上137名乘客與9名機組人員全數安全，旅客經緊急滑梯撤離，機場一度關閉。
body: 巴布亞紐幾內亞航空PX19航班波音767-300ER（註冊號P2-PXW）自香港國際機場飛往莫士比港傑克遜國際機場，於33000呎巡航、達沃東北方約160海里處，機組接獲右側普惠PW4060發動機火警指示。機組依緊急程序關閉並隔離受影響發動機，轉降達沃國際機場，於11月21日當地時間約凌晨0時08分降落05跑道，距接獲指示約45分鐘。巴布亞紐幾內亞航空其後證實機組在轉降前已關閉該發動機，飛機安全落地。
機上137名乘客與9名機組人員全數安全。落地後飛機滑行至4號滑行道，旅客與機組人員經緊急滑梯撤離；菲律賓民航局證實機上146人皆安全。其後評估指出右側起落架全部四個輪胎與機輪受損，飛機留在達沃並妥善固定，等待調查；菲律賓民航局已派出一名航空事故調查員，以查明事發經過與促成因素。
達沃國際機場為配合緊急應變與跑道安全檢查一度關閉，兩班自馬尼拉飛來的航班取消，分別為宿霧太平洋航空5J967航班與菲律賓航空快線PR2803航班；機場營運於11月21日當地時間約凌晨2時05分恢復。

en.title: Air Niugini Boeing 767 diverts to Davao after engine fire warning
en.summary: An Air Niugini Boeing 767-300ER diverted to Davao after the crew received an engine fire indication on its Hong Kong–Port Moresby flight; all 137 passengers and 9 crew members were safe after an emergency slide evacuation, and the airport briefly closed.
body: Air Niugini flight PX19, a Boeing 767-300ER registered P2-PXW, was flying from Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) to Port Moresby Jacksons International Airport (POM) when the crew received a fire indication on the right Pratt & Whitney PW4060 engine while cruising at FL330 about 160 nautical miles northeast of Davao. The crew shut down and secured the affected engine under emergency procedures and diverted to Davao International Airport, landing on runway 05 at about 00:08 a.m. local time on November 21, roughly 45 minutes after the indication. Air Niugini later confirmed the engine had been shut down before the diversion and that the aircraft landed safely.

All 137 passengers and nine crew members were safe. After landing, the aircraft taxied to Taxiway 4, where passengers and crew evacuated using the emergency slides; the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines (CAAP) confirmed all 146 people on board were safe. A later assessment found all four tyres and wheels on the right landing gear damaged. The aircraft remained in Davao, secured, while CAAP sent an aircraft accident investigator to establish what happened and what contributed to it.

Davao International Airport closed temporarily for the emergency response and runway safety checks, and two flights from Manila were cancelled — Cebu Pacific flight 5J 967 and PAL Express flight PR 2803. Airport operations resumed at about 02:05 a.m. local time on November 21.

facts.claim: Air Niugini flight PX19, a Boeing 767-300ER registered P2-PXW, was flying from Hong Kong to Port Moresby when the crew received a fire indication on the right Pratt & Whitney PW4060 engine at FL330 about 160 nautical miles northeast of Davao.

The crew shut down and secured the affected engine under emergency procedures and diverted to Davao, landing on runway 05 at about 00:08 a.m. local time on November 21, roughly 45 minutes after the indication.
All 137 passengers and nine crew members were safe; after taxiing to Taxiway 4, everyone evacuated via the emergency slides, and CAAP confirmed all 146 people on board were safe.
A later assessment found all four tyres and wheels on the right landing gear damaged, and the aircraft remained in Davao while CAAP sent an aircraft accident investigator.
Davao International Airport closed temporarily and two Manila flights were cancelled, Cebu Pacific 5J 967 and PAL Express PR 2803; operations resumed at about 02:05 a.m. local time on November 21.
